scope: Separate exploratory full hyperparameter-training extension of the same tensor identity; does not replace the primary baseline or results
baseline: scikit-learn GaussianProcessRegressor, ConstantKernel * anisotropic RBF + WhiteKernel, alpha=0, no normalize_y beyond common training-only centering, no restarts; optimizer uses identical scipy.optimize.minimize callback/settings
method: Exact full-rank tensor log marginal likelihood and analytic gradients, same optimizer/bounds/initialization, final full-rank tensor posterior
initial_theta_log: log([1.0,0.18,0.23,0.0025]), order signal variance, lengthscale x, lengthscale y, observation noise variance
data_and_quality: same latent function, noise-generating distribution, independent test seed and frozen quality tolerances as primary. Learned noise variance used for each model's predictive NLL. No tuning using test values.
timing: cold subprocess including imports, input, centering, all optimizer evaluations and rejected line searches, final refit, all posterior mean/variance predictions, metrics and output
completion_policy: Do not start a full case if its timeout would overlap research minute 83; preserve any unstarted plan in an unfinished file. Incomplete studies never count as a confirmed result.
gradient_validation: Compare objective and full analytic gradient against independent sklearn GPR and finite differences on small grids before timing; fixed tolerances atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-6 for validation gradients, not a modification of the primary held-out quality rule
